title: Podcast Studio
summary: A three-week podcast unit for grades 9–12: listen like a producer, plan and script a show, then record and publish it.

steps.caption: The student view. Each student plans their own show, solo or with a crew.
Three weeks of work. “This week” always points to where the class is.
Every week has an essential question and short steps: lessons, assignments and discussions.
Students work right on the page. Their writing saves itself as they type.

steps.text: Why do some people stay afraid of small things for their whole lives?

steps.caption: When it’s ready, they turn it in. It shows up on the teacher’s dashboard.
The teacher dashboard. Students join with a class code.
Every assignment is a tile. A red number means work is waiting for you.
Grade with the rubric beside each student’s work.
Focused grading: one student at a time, rubric beside the work.
